about: A phone number field with a country picker. The number formats as a person types it, and the field reports it in E.164 once it is valid, the one form two records of one phone share.

callback.about: `name` submits the E.164 form from a hidden input, and the form refuses a number that is not valid. A field's `required` applies to the number and not to the picker.
callback.error: Enter a phone number we can call.
callback.helper: We call back within one working day.
callback.label: Your phone number
callback.title: In a form

contact.about: Type a national number, or a number with its country code: `+44 20 7183 8750` moves the picker to the United Kingdom. Picking a country keeps the digits and writes them in that country's international form.
contact.title: A phone number

draft: Type the number with or without its country code.

everywhere.about: Without `countries` the picker offers all 245 regions, named and sorted in the page's language. Type the first letters of a country's name to move to it.
everywhere.helper: Pick your country, or type the number with its country code.
everywhere.title: Every country

flags.about: `flagOf` returns a glyph for each country, here the emoji flag its region code spells. A flag is hidden from a screen reader, which hears the country's name.
flags.helper: Emoji flags are missing on Windows, where a region shows its two letters.
flags.title: Flags

label: Phone number

national.about: Without a picker, `defaultCountry` is the country a number without a `+` is read in, and a mark takes the picker's place.
national.helper: A number in the United States, or any number with its country code.
national.label: Office phone
national.title: Without a picker

size.about: Every size of the input group. The picker's button is as tall as the group's square trigger at each size.
size.title: Sizes

title: Phone input
